items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: And I don't know much as well. I don't think, I had a time of playing in there too. I can't think of them guys.

ctx.x: Preservation Hall in the past quarter?
No, I didn't. Once I played down at one carnival I'd be, no I ain't never played.

Well they've got a lot of good guys around there that's playing music, I can't think of them right now, that ain't never played down there. That's why they're down there borrowing money on the next job and all that kind of stuff. You see I'd rather do something if it was a quarter. I'd rather work and make me honest. You understand I mean music is a art. And you see like when I was playing music and things way back then, fellas like Sheep used to carry them people's instruments, who used to play with her, they…
